name: CloudNativePG
summary: AI-generated code, docs or comments are accepted if the contributor fully understands and can explain every line, guarantees licensing and provenance, and discloses significant AI use with an Assisted-by trailer. Unvetted boilerplate, AI-hallucinated fixes, unsolicited AI refactors and vague AI-written PR descriptions are prohibited.

evidence.quote: You must fully understand every line of code you submit.
If you cannot guarantee the provenance and legal safety of the AI-generated code, do not submit it.

If AI was used to generate a significant portion of your contribution (beyond simple autocomplete), we ask that you disclose it in the PR description and through an `Assisted-by:` commit message trailer
Using AI to write PR descriptions that are vague, overly flowery, or fail to accurately describe the technical changes.
